scope: One-time visual inspection of five completed PNG artifacts only: labels, axes, units, legends, visible panel completeness and presentation-level consistency. No numerical results were inferred or checked against underlying data.

inspection_method.tool_result: Blocked by bwrap namespace permission error
inspection_method.fallback: Original PNG bytes were read through an escalated read-only file command and forwarded as image content for direct visual inspection. Original files were not resized or modified; the display automatically resized the largest image.

figures.readability: Titles, axes and the development legend are readable, with no visible text clipping.
figures.axes_units_legends: Both axes are labelled as rates; the development y axis spans 0 to 1. The empty test/stress x axes show negative rate ticks from automatic empty-axis scaling.
figures.panels: Development curves are present. Test and stress panels contain no curves, markers, legend or explanation for missing data.
figures.visible_claim_consistency: The titles identify three bank-specific dial comparisons, but only the development comparison is visibly supplied.

figures.readability: Title, bank labels, long count-axis label and three-component legend are readable. No obvious text or bar clipping.
figures.axes_units_legends: Bank categories and false-safe decision counts at m=0 are explicit; legend maps temporal sampling, readout and imagination to distinct colors.
figures.panels: One complete stacked-bar panel with dev, test and stress categories.
figures.visible_claim_consistency: The first-failing-link title and stacked attribution categories are consistent at the visual presentation level.

figures.readability: Both panels, their titles, integer horizon ticks and legend text are readable. Some series overlap visibly.
figures.axes_units_legends: Center-error units are pixels and angle-error units are degrees in panel titles; both state mean error. The x axis identifies block 0 as the current frame. Twelve legend entries use a repeated color cycle with identical markers/line style.
figures.panels: Both center and angle error panels contain plotted series.
figures.visible_claim_consistency: Titles identify quantities and units, but repeated styles prevent an unambiguous mapping of every visible curve to its legend entry.

figures.readability: All three titles, axis labels and the shared six-category legend are readable. The tallest final-horizon bars meet the top axis boundary, leaving no visible headroom; actual value clipping cannot be established visually.
figures.axes_units_legends: Prefix horizon is stated in action blocks, and the y axes name observed false-safe imagined decisions at m=0. Category colors are distinct.
figures.panels: All three dev/test/stress panels are populated; legends may include categories with no visually apparent nonzero segment.
figures.visible_claim_consistency: Panel titles and count-axis labels are consistent with cumulative-horizon attribution. No numeric correctness claim is made by this audit.

figures.readability: The nine-panel grid has readable titles, ticks and horizon labels at inspection scale. No obvious missing panel, cropped label or clipped series.
figures.axes_units_legends: Center and signed-clearance errors use pixels; periodic-angle errors use degrees. The shared legend identifies pusher contact, free motion, rotation >=10 degrees and near-boundary regimes. Signed-clearance panels show a zero reference line.
figures.panels: All nine panels contain plotted series, arranged by bank and error quantity.
figures.visible_claim_consistency: The figure declares unsupported targets omitted. A standalone reader is not told the subtraction order for signed clearance error, so positive/negative values cannot be interpreted as optimistic/pessimistic from the image alone.

findings.issue: Unexplained empty test and stress dial panels, with negative acceptance-rate ticks from empty-axis defaults.
findings.suggested_followup: Check the plotting/data-selection path. If curves are available, provide them in a new corrected artifact; if intentionally unavailable, explicitly label the panels and reason. Preserve the completed original artifact.

findings.issue: Identical blue styles label dev/real_readout and stress/coord_mlp; identical orange styles label dev/imagined and stress/endpoint. Marker and line styles do not disambiguate these repeated colors.
findings.suggested_followup: Use distinct or systematic bank/source line-and-marker styles in any later corrected figure, or separate banks into panels; preserve the original artifact.

findings.issue: Tallest final-horizon stacks meet the upper axes boundary with no headroom; visually this makes completeness harder to assess. Actual clipping is not established.
findings.suggested_followup: Allow a little upper-axis headroom in a later presentation revision.

findings.issue: The signed-clearance error subtraction order is not visible in the standalone figure.
findings.suggested_followup: State the actual sign convention in a later caption or axis label before interpreting positive/negative errors.
